text:
nisha: FYI deploy-bot auto-paused the cut. Staging canaries failing during artifact push; multipart uploads hitting timeouts and registry returning 503 slow_downs.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_upload_throttle).

nisha: Quick paste from the uploader: 
```
chunk upload failed: write timeout after 28s
registry: 503 slow_down (x42)
cache-mirror: queue depth=512, evictions rising
```

devops: This looks like a cache shard tail-latency problem we saw last week. Short-term options: lower multipart concurrency, route to fallback registry, or pin to a known-good image and rerun CI.

release-coordinator: Change window opens in ~30m. Recommend manual pin to last-known-good SHA to avoid forcing a rollback mid-window. We'll document the pin in release notes.

nisha: Agree. I'll open a promo-pin and trigger a rerun with concurrency=2.

ci-bot: Queued rerun on pinned image: pipeline #5044.

nisha: Promo-pin PR: https://deploybot/internal/pins/1758009999 1 pinned sha256:0b4f3e7d. PR note: "pin due to artifact upload throttling / cache shard backpressure". Also set uploader_concurrency=2 for the rerun.

devops: Investigating shard-9. Seeing high write amplification because many small chunk writes are serialized; bumping write buffer and temporarily increasing shard group. Will report ETA within 8-10m.

release-coordinator: I'll update release notes: "Cut held - pinned to last-good image due to artifact upload throttling; infra investigating cache shard write tail latency." Marking the promotion as "held - pinned" on the tracker.

nisha: If infra stabilizes quickly we can unpin and proceed inside the window. If not, we keep the pin and move the promotion to the next change window. Adding follow-up checklist to the ticket: uploader logs, shard write latency (P50/P95/P99), registry 503 counts, deploy-bot backpressure metrics.

devops: Quick update: scaled shard group and increased buffer; queue depth trending down and 503s decreasing. Recommend waiting 6m for stability before deciding.

release-coordinator: Hold for 6m then decide. Posting updates to #release-updates and tagging oncall.

nisha: Confirmed promo pinned and rerun queued. Will report status after rerun completes or if devops asks to unpin.
